usagePolicy: Editorial art or labelled demo imagery only. Never use as care evidence, a real horse profile, session video, camera stream, or identity record. Fictional subjects; no people likeness.

assets.cropFocalPoint: centre cover-crop; subject upper right; quiet lower half for the sign-in form
assets.prompt: Photorealistic editorial portrait of a black Marwari horse with distinctive inward-curved ear tips touching, accurate equine anatomy, head and neck positioned in the upper right of the frame, warm amber sunset rim light outlining the mane and ears, deep espresso-brown shadows, subtle atmospheric dust in the backlight, refined Indian equestrian academy stable courtyard softly out of focus, simple leather bridle with realistic tack, restrained cinematic film grain, large quiet dark area in the lower half for overlaid interface text. No people, no text, no logos, no watermark, single horse, no extra ears or legs.

assets.cropFocalPoint: centre cover-crop; horse centre-left; use a bottom scrim for copy (lower-left is not fully quiet)
assets.prompt: Photorealistic editorial scene at a refined Indian equestrian academy at golden hour: a bay Marwari horse with inward-curved ears standing calmly beside a sand arena rail, sandstone arches and neem trees softly blurred behind, warm amber sunset light from upper right, deep espresso shadows, light dust haze, realistic saddle and bridle, cinematic restrained grain, uncluttered darker negative space in the lower left for interface copy. No people, no text, no logos, no watermark, accurate anatomy, four legs, one head.

assets.use: FA-07 Horse (labelled demo imagery, not the real assigned horse)
assets.cropFocalPoint: centre cover-crop; head upper centre; white star forehead marking is the consistent fictional identity
assets.prompt: Photorealistic three-quarter portrait of a fictional dark bay Marwari horse with a small white star on the forehead and characteristic inward-curved ear tips, accurate equine anatomy, calm expression, in a quiet stable aisle with warm amber evening light streaming from behind, deep espresso shadows, fine dust particles, realistic leather halter, shallow depth of field, restrained cinematic grain, clean darker lower area for interface text. No people, no text, no logos, no watermark, single horse.

assets.cropFocalPoint: centre cover-crop; silhouette upper half; controls over the lower two thirds
assets.prompt: Abstract atmospheric artwork: the soft silhouette of a horse head and arched neck in deep espresso shadow against a glowing amber and golden-orange backlight haze, light fog and floating dust, smooth gradient from pale soft amber at the top to burnt sienna and near-black espresso at the bottom, photographic, calm and meditative, generous empty space in the middle and lower third for white text and translucent controls. No people, no text, no logos, no watermark.

assets.use: FA-09/FA-10 event imagery (editorial, not an event photo)
assets.cropFocalPoint: centre cover-crop; arena centre; distant figures are backlit and unidentifiable
assets.prompt: Photorealistic wide view of an Indian equestrian academy riding arena at golden hour, raked sand arena with white rails and show jumps, sandstone pavilion with arches in the background, two fictional riderless horses in the distance being led by figures too small and backlit to identify, warm amber sunset light, long shadows, gentle dust haze, deep espresso foreground shadow along the bottom edge, cinematic restrained grain. No text, no logos, no banners, no watermark, no identifiable faces.

assets.cropFocalPoint: centre; still life right of centre; decorative only
assets.prompt: Photorealistic minimal still life for an equestrian academy credential: a folded dark espresso leather riding glove, a polished brass stirrup and a coil of tan leather rein resting on dark walnut wood, warm amber side light, deep shadows, soft specular highlights on brass, subtle grain, lots of quiet dark negative space. No text, no logos, no insignia, no emblems, no watermark.
